JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

articles.headline: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot, expected to be out indefinitely
articles.summary: The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

articles.headline: Sources: Eagles' Jalen Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR
articles.summary: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.
